QUOTE: `NavigationHeader` is a `forwardRef<SearchRef, Props>`. When `hasSearch` is true, it renders `<NavigationSearch … ref={ref} />` (index.tsx, around line 128–137). It does not use the ref itself.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says NavigationHeader forwards its ref to NavigationSearch, which is rendered only when `hasSearch` is true. It doesn't say the ref attaches to nothing otherwise, but that follows from the conditional rendering.
